'''Teega Kryelle'''<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> was a [[human]] who was a part of the [[Hidden Path]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Teega Kryelle first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Part IV]]" of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', directed by [[Deborah Chow]]<ref name="Part IV" /> and released on [[June 8]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}}</ref> The character was portrayed by [[Krystina Arielle]]<ref name="BTS Kenobi">{{SWYouTube|ufI9DDBJVGs|Behind the Scenes of the Obi-Wan Kenobi Series!|sw_url=video/behind-the-scenes-of-the-obi-wan-kenobi-series}}</ref> and later given a name in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="Guide" />
